evidence_grade: A for negative/correction evidence from official and local-government sources; no verified Meta-owned Catawba County data-center expansion found

sources.match_reason: Seed-only Meta/Catawba label not corroborated by official/local-government sources; current public Catawba County hyperscale data-center records identify Microsoft, while Meta's official North Carolina data-center listing identifies Forest City.

refresh_sources.title: Catawba County: Microsoft to Invest $1B in Technology Facilities in Catawba County
refresh_sources.fact: Catawba County announced Microsoft plans for at least $1 billion and four datacenters in Conover, Hickory and Maiden over 10 years.

refresh_sources.title: Catawba County/EDC joint statement on Microsoft data-center development
refresh_sources.fact: Local governments reaffirmed the Catawba County data-center project as Microsoft, and described all data-center sites in Catawba County as existing or under construction with City of Hickory water service.

refresh_sources.title: Catawba County FY2025 ACFR
refresh_sources.fact: County financial report states Microsoft announced four Catawba County data centers in November 2022 and that construction of the first data center started in April 2024.

refresh_sources.title: Meta Data Centers - United States locations
refresh_sources.fact: Meta's official U.S. data-center fleet lists North Carolina as Forest City only; no Catawba County or Claremont Meta data-center location is listed.

refresh_sources.title: Catawba County EDC: Corning and Meta cable manufacturing expansion
refresh_sources.fact: Meta is tied locally to Corning's Hickory optical-cable manufacturing expansion as anchor customer, not to a Meta-owned data-center expansion in Catawba County.

contradictions.issue: Seed label says Meta Catawba County data-center expansion, but official/local-government sources identify the Catawba County data-center program as Microsoft; Meta's official North Carolina data-center location is Forest City.
contradictions.resolution: Retain seed-only record but mark as unverified/likely conflated pending authoritative evidence of a Meta-owned Catawba County data center.

history.change: First independent refresh found no official support for the Meta/Catawba data-center seed label; official evidence points to Microsoft for Catawba County data centers and to Meta only for Forest City data centers or Corning's Hickory cable manufacturing expansion.
